ValidationRule.description: Terminal ID of Loyaltek needs to start with 20 or 23
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c) && (ER_Business_Unit__c ='BENELUX') && ISPICKVAL( ER_Acceptor_Scheme__c ,'C-TAP') && ISPICKVAL(ER_Acceptor_Provider__c,'Loyaltek') && NOT( ( BEGINS(ER_TID_Authorization__c,"20") || BEGINS(ER_TID_Authorization__c,"23") )) && NOT(ISBLANK(ER_TID_Authorization__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Terminal ID of Loyaltek needs to start with 20 or 23
